description: Execute a SOSL search to search across multiple Salesforce objects. Use when you need to search for text across multiple object types simultaneously.

q.description: SOSL search query string to execute. Must follow SOSL syntax with FIND clause. Special characters and spaces must be URL-encoded. Example: 'FIND {Acme} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Name, Phone), Contact(FirstName, LastName)'
examples: FIND {test} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Id, Name) LIMIT 5
FIND {Acme} IN NAME FIELDS RETURNING Account(Name, Phone)
FIND {tech*} IN ALL FIELDS RETURNING Account(Name), Lead(Name, Company)
q.human_parameter_description: The SOSL search query to execute. Use FIND clause to specify search terms and RETURNING clause to specify objects and fields to retrieve.
q.title: Q

name: execute_sosl_search

ExecuteSoslSearchResponse.description: Response from executing a SOSL search against Salesforce data.

searchRecords.description: Array containing all records that match the search criteria across multiple object types. Returns empty array when no records match.
searchRecords.title: Search Records

ExecuteSoslSearchResponse.title: ExecuteSoslSearchResponse

SearchRecord.description: A single record returned by the SOSL search.

Id.description: The unique Salesforce record ID (15 or 18-character Salesforce ID). Only present if Id is included in the RETURNING clause.
Id.title: Id

SearchRecord.title: SearchRecord

SearchRecordAttributes.description: Metadata about the record, including type and URL for RESTful access.

type.description: The Salesforce object type of this record (e.g., Account, Contact, Lead).
type.title: Type

url.description: The REST API endpoint URL to directly access this specific record.
url.title: Url
